purpose: Teach: キルト/デッサン/ライフワーク/レインボー/ハヤカワ/ローソン/ベースボール/グリーンピース

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、キルトを縫うのがご趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer who does quilting—she told me about her hobby.
lines.style: Soft, noticing tone. Sharing an observation gently, as if watching Aoi connect with someone. Warm pause before the detail, like it mattered to see her pay attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、デッサンを毎日描いてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She sketches every day, apparently. That's what she was telling me about.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful rhythm. Matching Mei's warmth but with quiet interest—mirroring her friend's noticing. Slight lift at the detail, finding the same significance in small dedication.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、研究をライフワークとされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And her research—she treats it like a life's work, you know?
lines.style: Reflective, admiring undertone. Slower pace on 'life's work,' recognizing something serious and sustained. Soft landing, like she's impressed by the commitment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、レインボーのアートが大好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Rainbow art is her real love, though. You could see how much it matters to her.
lines.style: Warm recognition breaking through. A small smile in the voice. Light certainty on what brings her joy. The pleasure of spotting what someone truly cares about.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ハヤカワ文庫のSF小説を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: She was reading a Hayakawa science fiction novel when she came in.
lines.style: Noticing detail delivered with gentle curiosity. Even pace, but the title lands with slight weight—the kind of specific observation Mei makes naturally. Not laboring it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ローソンでお弁当買って来られたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Grabbed a bento from Lawson on the way, she mentioned.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact observance. A small smile for the ordinary detail. Warm without making anything of it—the way Aoi would notice and remember someone's routine.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ベースボールの観戦が趣味だって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Baseball—she loves watching games. That's something she's really into.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Slight warmth on 'really into,' recognizing a passion. Steady pace, like recording something worth remembering about her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、グリーンピースの活動に関心がおありだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: She's involved with Greenpeace work, too. Cares about it deeply.
lines.style: Warm closing observation. Tender respect for something that matters to someone. Slow fadeout at the end—Aoi recognizing the weight of what drives her customers. A small, genuine moment between friends.
